gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-001 identifies an algebraic-versus-exponential estimate and the need for additional remainder and tail bounds. It does not identify the distinct cutoff-support defect at the closed PML endpoints, the resulting missing nearest reflected kernel, or the failure of the all-boundary separated-remainder estimate.

Both identify that a convergence estimate is claimed for compact sets in the full truncated domain Ω_R even though the invoked exact/PDE estimate is proved only for compact subsets of the physical region Ω_p, with no argument extending the comparison into the PML region.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The computable or corrected-field convergence claim over Ω_R is unsupported because the proof transfers an estimate valid only on Ω_p without establishing a PML-region estimate; the adequate repair is to restrict the quantifier to Ω_p or supply the missing PML-layer argument.

component_coverage.gold_component: The theorem overclaims the compact-set convergence estimate on Ω_R while the available exact/PDE estimate and proof support only K compactly contained in Ω_p; no comparison through the PML region is established.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-003 explicitly diagnoses the unsupported Ω_R scope, states that the underlying theorem is only proved for Ω_p, notes the absence of a PML-region estimate, and proposes the same restriction or an added PML estimate.
